name: zodiac-hooks-pack
description: Reusable Claude Code hooks for the My Zodiac AI ecosystem (my_zodiac_ai, companion-ai, astro-ai-landing). Self-detecting, fail-soft, individually disable-able. Covers sensitive-file blocking, ESLint --fix, TypeScript checks, Prisma migration reminders, GSAP import guards, @nuxt/content frontmatter validation, Serena session reminders, and i18n hardcoded-string warnings.
